title: Icosahedral 20-Face Partition Authority
objective: Generate and version the spherical icosahedral partition used by the locked profile EARTH_ROOT_D_V1.

implementation.digest: sha256 over versioned, rounded, numbered geometry (deterministic, no wall-clock)
implementation.root_binding: select_root(direction) classifies an operator-supplied root direction to a face centre and the matching dodeca-dual vertex id

negative_results: A face id is a cell of a synthetic tessellation, not a place; the partition asserts nothing geographic.
Binding a root face to a direction is an operator selection, not a measured coordinate and not a validated source origin.
Bumping the partition version mints a new digest/id: a post-freeze regrid is not silent (no result shopping).

claims.statement: The 20-face partition and its face-centre root selection are versioned and content-hashed over the reused, deterministic engine icosahedron.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public geometry only; no private reads, no personal names or filesystem literals
